api_contract.versioning: ui_spec relies on NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to encode /api/v1 prefix per DS-010; backend mounts routers under /api/v1 in T-023. Consistent.

DesignGradeMap Read body contains joined design_name + grade_code — UI table columns rely on these fields; matches T-015 list_mappings behaviour.

warnings.issue: ui_spec prioritises `response.data.message` over `response.data.detail`. FastAPI HTTPException default response shape is `{detail: '...'}` (no `message`). Backend T-008 register_error_handlers maps DomainError to FastAPI HTTPException, so the live wire shape is `{detail}`.
warnings.impact: Functionally OK — interceptor falls through to `detail` as second candidate. TC-043/TC-045 will still see toast text containing 'grade_code' / '(design_id, grade_id)'. But the priority order disagrees with LLD T-027 plan which puts `detail` first.
warnings.recommendation: During /ases-ui-scaffold, implement the interceptor as: `detail ?? message ?? error.message ?? 'Request failed'`. Align with LLD T-027 plan.md.

warnings.issue: Reactivate is documented as PATCH /{entity}/{id} { is_active: true }. LLD SupplierUpdate (et al.) schema description says 'All fields Optional; partial update' — does not explicitly list is_active in the Pydantic schema. Backend should accept it since service.update is a generic dict-patch via repo.update.
warnings.impact: Works in practice (T-007 schemas + T-010 service propagate the dict). Strictly speaking, the LLD Pydantic Update schema should declare is_active: Optional[bool].
warnings.recommendation: Make sure /ases-dev T-007 explicitly includes `is_active: bool | None` in each SupplierUpdate/StaffUpdate/etc. schema. The ui_spec.plumbing_components.types_masters already lists is_active? in TS Update DTOs — backend should mirror.

warnings.topic: AC-019 contract surface unused by S1 admin UI
warnings.issue: designsApi.getGrades is exposed but no S1 page calls it. AC-019 is covered at API + service test level only.
warnings.impact: Acceptable — DF-006 contract is delivered for S2 (transaction forms) per LLD and tasks.json. No UI gap.
warnings.recommendation: No action. /ases-ui-scaffold MUST still emit designsApi.getGrades so S2 can import it without rewriting masters.ts.

warnings.issue: Scaffold-phase mocks throw synthetic 409 for duplicate grade_code (TC-043) and duplicate (design_id, grade_id) (TC-045). The thrown shape MUST match the live backend shape (`{detail: '...'}`) so the same toast handler works under both modes.
warnings.impact: If mocks throw `{message: '...'}` the toast string will work but TC-043/045 assertions on the resolved error key may diverge between scaffold and integration phase.
warnings.recommendation: In /ases-ui-scaffold, the mock-throwing code MUST emit the same `{ status, detail }` shape returned by apiClient's interceptor (which itself reads detail per W-001 recommendation). Document this in mocks.ts as a one-line comment.

warnings.topic: Status badge cell rendering not specified for is_active column
warnings.issue: Every entity table_columns lists an `is_active` column with label 'Status', but MasterDataTable rendering logic in shared_components defaults to `String(row[key] ?? '')` for cell content. ui_spec.status_rendering describes Active/Inactive Badge styles but does not specify how MasterDataTable maps a boolean column key to those badges.
warnings.impact: Without a per-column renderer override, the table will display literal 'true'/'false' text instead of the Active/Inactive Badge. Cosmetic — does not break ACs.
warnings.recommendation: Either (a) extend MasterDataTable column definition with an optional `render?: (row: T) => ReactNode` per column, OR (b) special-case the `is_active` key inside MasterDataTable to render the Badge. /ases-ui-scaffold should pick one approach and apply uniformly across all 6 pages.

summary.rationale: All 13 UI-relevant ACs in S1 scope (AC-001/002/004/005/007/008/011/012/013/015/016/017/019) have at least one component implementing them. M-006 boundary is clean — only M-001 endpoints are consumed. All 7 endpoint namespaces and all 7 DTO type signatures match the LLD definitions byte-for-byte. Five non-blocking warnings flagged for /ases-ui-scaffold attention (error-key precedence, is_active Update schema field, AC-019 latent contract, mock 409 shape, is_active column renderer). None of these block scaffold execution.
